acceptance_rate.description: Share of recommendations whose latest published decision is accepted_for_future_planning.

deferral_rate.description: Share whose latest decision is deferred.

rejection_rate.description: Share whose latest decision is rejected.

recommendation_aging_days.description: Mean elapsed time to latest decision, or observation time while unresolved.

engineering_throughput.description: Published completed or merged item count.

merge_cadence.description: Published merged/completed item count per observation.

validation_completion_rate.description: Complete/passed share in published validation evidence.

blocker_frequency.description: Share of queue items carrying blockers.

stale_work_rate.description: Share of queue items published as stale.

queue_stability.description: Single-snapshot stability baseline; comparison reports expose change.

engineering_lane_utilization.description: Published queue item counts grouped by lane.

high_merge_risk_rate.description: Share published with high merge risk.

technical_debt_rate.description: Share explicitly published as technical debt.
